review_note: Diagonal finiteness of a double complex ensures convergence of both associated spectral sequences to Tot cohomology and weak Serre propagation. Matched against the pinned original theorem text in the Stage A source packet; did not open proof/remark text. Preliminary decision only.
statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category. Let $K^{\bullet, \bullet}$
be a double complex. Assume that for every $n \in \mathbf{Z}$ there are
only finitely many nonzero $K^{p, q}$ with $p + q = n$. Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item the two spectral sequences associated to $K^{\bullet, \bullet}$
are bounded,
\item the filtrations $F_I$, $F_{II}$ on each
$H^n(\text{Tot}(K^{\bullet, \bullet}))$ are finite,
\item the spectral sequences $({}'E_r, {}'d_r)_{r \geq 0}$ and
$({}''E_r, {}''d_r)_{r \geq 0}$ converge to
$H^*(\text{Tot}(K^{\bullet, \bullet}))$,
\item if $\mathcal{C} \subset \mathcal{A}$ is a weak Serre subcategory
and for some $r$ we have ${}'E_r^{p, q} \in \mathcal{C}$ for all
$p, q \in \mathbf{Z}$, then $H^n(\text{Tot}(K^{\bullet, \bullet}))$
is in $\mathcal{C}$. Similarly for $({}''E_r, {}''d_r)_{r \geq 0}$.
\end{enumerate}
hypotheses: Let $K^{\bullet,\bullet}$ be a double complex in an abelian category with only finitely many nonzero terms on every diagonal $p+q=n$.
conclusions: Both associated spectral sequences are bounded and converge to the total-complex cohomology.
Both induced filtrations on cohomology are finite.
Weak Serre membership on some page propagates to the limiting cohomology for either spectral sequence.
